scripts.features:
BARRAGE - Sword Fighting Tournament

Update Log & Feature List

AUTOMATED COMBAT & HEALING PIPELINE





Auto Equip & Loadout Selection: Automatically equips chosen owned swords upon entering matches or respawning, with automatic fallback to available round weapons and full support for manual hotbar overrides.



Auto Swing Engine: Performs rapid Slash/Lunge combat sequences while strictly respecting native weapon cooldowns. Features customizable Swing Rate pacing (0–20 cycles/second; 0 applies no extra rate limit).



Auto Medikit & Healing: Automated health recovery triggers an owned Medikit once dropping below a customizable health threshold (Medikit Health: 1–200 HP, default 50 HP). Features a strict single-attempt limit per life, full-health usage protection, and an automatic Re-Equip Sword routine post-healing.

HITBOX EXTENDER & VISUAL TELEMETRY





Dynamic Hitbox Extender: Expands physical contact parts on selected blades along customizable dimensions:





Hitbox Length: Adds 1–25 studs along the blade's primary axis.



Hitbox Girth: Adds 0–25 studs to blade width and thickness.



Hitbox Presets: Legit (+1 length, +0 girth), Blatant (+25 length, +5 girth), and Custom (user-defined dimensions).



Weapon Targeting & Hitbox ESP: Granular Apply To weapon filtering (includes Practice Sword and dynamically acquired weapons by default) paired with a real-time Hitbox ESP outline. Supports full color customization (Blue, Cyan, Green, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, White, Yellow).
